name: symbol_image
expr: [(n, [(str(s.Symbol.Style.value), s.Symbol.Graphic is not None, s.Symbol.Graphic.Type if s.Symbol.Graphic is not None else None, s.Symbol.Size.Width, s.Symbol.Size.Height) for s in sh.Charts.getByName(n).EmbeddedObject.getFirstDiagram().getCoordinateSystems()[0].getChartTypes()[0].getDataSeries()]) for sh in [doc.Sheets.getByIndex(0)] for n in sh.Charts.ElementNames]

name: series_data
expr: [(n, [[list(q.Values.getData()) for q in s.getDataSequences()] for s in sh.Charts.getByName(n).EmbeddedObject.getFirstDiagram().getCoordinateSystems()[0].getChartTypes()[0].getDataSeries()]) for sh in [doc.Sheets.getByIndex(0)] for n in sh.Charts.ElementNames]
